description: The forms case for React: a controlled textarea (onChange is the input event; React DOM keeps its text content, defaultValue, equal to the value), a label htmlFor focusing it, a label wrapping a checkbox toggling it, a label wrapping a text input focusing it. Unlike Svelte, controlled values that nothing writes are restored after every event (React DOM's restoreControlledState): the toggled checkbox and the typed text revert at once. Their onChange handlers do nothing (without one React warns about a read-only field). The actions are the forms case's
